identity: Highcourt is safe inside its walls; outside them, private collectors dress their charges as royal tolls.

quests.title: The Dead Cannot Owe Toll
quests.text: Debtbound Zombies wander the {name:commons} {zone_area:commons} every night, still clutching the toll slips somebody sold them. Put five of them to rest after dark. Whoever wrote those slips is our real problem, and the dead keep excellent records.
quests.lesson: Night work near the capital; zombies burn at dawn.

quests.title: Archers in the Deer Park
quests.text: The slips lead to Toll Bandit Archers who shoot at anyone crossing the {name:deer_park} {dir_of:highcourt:deer_park} after dark. Defeat five of them there at night. The crown keeps no archers in its deer park, whatever their badges claim.
quests.lesson: Ranged night roster in a forest; daytime there is quiet.

quests.title: The Last Unauthorised Stamp
quests.text: {name:tollmaster_penn} runs the {name:toll_camp} {dir_from_giver:toll_camp} as if it were a royal office. Defeat five of his Toll Bandit Archers and then Penn himself. With his stamp gone, nobody collects tolls in the crown's name but the crown.
quests.lesson: Archer camp plus its named normal leader.

quests.title: A Peg for the Bread Board
quests.text: Bring me one Gnarled Boar Tusk from a Furrow Boar on the {name:commons}; they graze there by day and only fight back when struck. I need a new peg for my bread board, and I refuse to borrow one from the king's kitchen.
quests.lesson: A daytime errand that leaves your enchant stock alone.

quests.title: Vixens in the Royal Orchards
quests.text: Redfang Vixens raid the {name:orchards} {zone_area:orchards} by day and bite the pickers. Hunt five of them. Unlike the Orchard Foxes, these start the fight, so mind their red names.
quests.lesson: Aggressive and neutral foxes share one orchard.

quests.title: Bounty: Razorbacks
quests.text: Razorbacks root up the {name:outer_fields} {zone_area:outer_fields} faster than anyone can replant them. Bring down six by day and I will pay again each time. The next bounty opens twenty-five minutes after you hand this one in.
quests.lesson: Repeatable bounty in the late outskirts.

quests.title: The Empty River Baskets
quests.text: Find Merren Oakstamp at Whitebridge Market Close in Whitebridge Shire. The river baskets I paid for never reached my kitchen, and Merren knows who sold them twice. Follow the road, or ask the stables about a mount to save your feet.

quests.title: Bread for the March
quests.text: Take word to Toren Waterbarrel at Cinderline Watch in Ashenward March. The watch eats my bread and fights for the whole Accord; it could use someone who has cleared Penn's camp. Reach level 30 before you go, because the march does not forgive.
